summary: Evaluate a local gyrotropic pressure diagnostic with an explicitly supplied fixed-flux derivative. Return the named fields as a scirel._result.Result mapping.

capability: Evaluate local gyrotropic parallel-pressure compatibility from parallel pressure, perpendicular pressure and field samples.
operation: gyrotropic parallel-pressure compatibility residual for an explicit fixed-flux law
parallel and perpendicular pressures plus field samples -> expected perpendicular pressure, error metrics and pass flag
discovery.model: Gyrotropic parallel-pressure compatibility for an explicitly specified fixed-flux law; not a spatial force-balance residual.
discovery.geometry: Explicit fixed-psi pressure law or caller-designated sample lines whose flux label is constant along field_axis.
discovery.boundary: An explicit derivative may be scalar, broadcastable or callable(B,psi); otherwise B must be strictly monotone along each constant-psi line, and constant-field data require explicit derivative information.

identity.relation: Parallel pressure and magnetic-field samples to an expected perpendicular pressure and residual
identity.direction: (p_parallel, p_perp, B) -> rhs, error, relative_error, aggregate errors, passed
identity.definition: rhs=p_parallel-B*(partial p_parallel/partial B)_psi, algebraically equal to -B^2*partial(p_parallel/B)/partial B at fixed psi. error=p_perp-rhs; relative_error=abs(error)/max(abs(p_perp),abs(rhs),atol). passed means max(relative_error)<=rtol. All named fields are returned together in a scirel._result.Result mapping; mapping and attribute access expose the same values.
identity.model: Gyrotropic parallel-pressure compatibility for an explicitly specified fixed-flux law; not a spatial force-balance residual.
identity.geometry: Explicit fixed-psi pressure law or caller-designated sample lines whose flux label is constant along field_axis.
identity.coordinates: Magnetic-field magnitude B at fixed flux label psi; arrays are never flattened and globally sorted to infer this partial derivative.
identity.boundary: An explicit derivative may be scalar, broadcastable array, or callable(B,psi). Alternatively supply field_axis and psi: B must be strictly monotone along each line, with at least two samples, and psi exactly constant along that axis. Constant-field data require explicit derivative information; no zero-derivative fallback exists.
assumptions: B is a positive magnitude in T and both pressures use Pa.
The caller supplies a true fixed-flux partial derivative or valid fixed-psi sampling geometry.
Finite differences have endpoint/sampling error; a successful numerical diagnostic is not a spatial force-balance or global-stability proof.

inputs.name: p_parallel
inputs.shape: nonempty scalar or array; exactly the same shape as p_perp and magnetic_field
inputs.constraints: All values finite; negative values are not rejected.

inputs.name: p_perp
inputs.shape: exactly the same shape as p_parallel
inputs.constraints: All values finite; negative values are not rejected.

inputs.name: magnetic_field
inputs.description: Positive magnetic-field magnitude at the pressure samples.
inputs.shape: exactly the same shape as p_parallel
inputs.constraints: Finite strictly positive values, same shape as pressures. Duplicate B values are allowed with an explicit derivative; sampled fixed-flux lines require strict monotonicity.

inputs.name: rtol
inputs.description: Maximum allowed normalized residual for the passed flag.

inputs.name: atol
inputs.description: Absolute pressure scale flooring the normalized-residual denominator.

inputs.name: strict
inputs.description: When truthy, raise if the maximum normalized residual exceeds rtol.
inputs.constraints: Interpreted by Python truth value; the implementation does not enforce bool type.

inputs.name: dp_parallel_dB
inputs.shape: scalar/array broadcastable to B, callable(B,psi), or None
inputs.constraints: Required unless field_axis and psi are supplied; finite on evaluation. Cannot be combined with field_axis.

inputs.name: field_axis
inputs.description: Axis along which each sample line varies B while holding psi fixed.
inputs.constraints: With no explicit derivative, requires >=2 samples, strictly monotone B on every line, and constant psi along the axis.

inputs.name: psi
inputs.description: Flux labels for fixed-flux sample lines or explicit derivative callable.
inputs.constraints: Mandatory and finite for field_axis mode, exactly constant along that axis. Forwarded to a derivative callable otherwise.

outputs.name: rhs
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: p_parallel-B*dp_parallel_dB at fixed psi.
outputs.constraints: Finite on successful return. Uniform isotropic pressure passes with explicit zero derivative.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: signed perpendicular-pressure residual p_perp-rhs.

outputs.name: relative_error
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: absolute residual divided by max(abs(p_perp),abs(rhs),atol).
outputs.constraints: Finite and non-negative on successful return.

outputs.name: max_relative_error
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: maximum of all pointwise relative errors.

outputs.name: mean_relative_error
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: mean of all pointwise relative errors.

outputs.name: passed
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: whether max_relative_error is at most rtol.
outputs.constraints: No result is returned on failure when strict is truthy.

outputs.name: dp_parallel_dB
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: fixed-psi derivative used by the diagnostic.

outputs.name: derivative_method
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: how the fixed-flux derivative was obtained.
outputs.constraints: Explicit derivative or fixed-psi axis finite difference.

preconditions: Positive B with finite, shape-consistent pressure samples.
Explicit fixed-psi derivative or genuine constant-psi sample lines.
supported: Scalars and arbitrary sample layouts with an explicit derivative.
Monotone B sampling independently along each fixed-psi line; at least two samples per line.
excluded: Inferring a fixed-psi derivative from an unstructured spatial cloud or constant-B data alone.
General Hall-flow, finite-Larmor-radius, finite-wave-number or global stability conclusions.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for missing derivative information, conflicting derivative/axis inputs, nonfinite or nonpositive B, invalid shapes or nonmonotone/variable-psi derivative lines; other documented scalar controls are validated.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError for nonfinite computed residuals or margins; callable errors propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No nonlinear solve; the caller is responsible for derivative sampling convergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: None; no scirel._result.Result mapping is returned on failure.

python.signature: compute_parallel_pressure_residual(p_parallel, p_perp, magnetic_field, rtol=0.01, atol=1e-06, strict=False, *, dp_parallel_dB=None, field_axis=None, psi=None)

example.description: Supply a zero derivative for uniform isotropic pressure, verify the fixed-flux relation and inspect the named result mapping.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel._result import Result
from scirel.diagnostics.parallel_pressure_residual import compute_parallel_pressure_residual
r=compute_parallel_pressure_residual([3.,3.],[3.,3.],[2.,2.],dp_parallel_dB=0.)
assert isinstance(r, Result)
assert r.error is r['error']
np.testing.assert_array_equal(r['error'],[0.,0.])
assert r['passed']
example.expected: The residual is zero with the original fields, order, values, shapes and dtypes, and the same field is available by mapping key and attribute through scirel._result.Result; no derivative is invented from constant-field samples.

scope: Explicit uniform-isotropic and fixed-psi multi-line polynomial regressions.
Sixty-three invariant bi-Maxwellian states cross-check pressure compatibility and total-pressure-slope threshold.
Four sample refinements demonstrate finite-difference convergence along fixed-psi lines.
Result wrapping preserves every key, key order, value, shape, dtype and mapping access against baseline 0f74255b; attribute access reaches the same fields.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Analytic identities, explicit failure regressions and independent numerical comparisons establish the stated mathematical contract. They do not establish measured-plasma validity or a general stability theorem.
known_limitations: The derivative/axis/psi keywords require callers to supply missing physical information; global-B sorting is not part of this contract.
Sampled flags and residuals are local model diagnostics, not proof of global equilibrium or kinetic stability.
